description: The four pie charts represent the distribution of categories for different language models, namely GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. Each chart is divided into a varying number of slices, with GPT4-o having 2 slices, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct having 2 slices, Llama3.1-405B-Instruct having 2 slices, and Gemini1.5-Pro having 5 slices. For GPT4-o, the slices are labeled "Lack of Knowledge" (dark red, approximately 83.3%) and "Safety" (light brown, approximately 16.7%). For Gemini1.5-Pro, the slices are labeled "Misinformation" (red, approximately 38.4%), "Lack of Knowledge" (blue, approximately 22.1%), "Ethical Advice" (yellow, approximately 16.3%), "Clarification" (brown, approximately 14.0%), and "Safety" (light brown, approximately 9.3%). For Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, the slices are labeled "Lack of Knowledge" (dark red, approximately 75.0%) and "Clarification" (brown, approximately 25.0%). For Llama3.1-405B-Instruct, the slices are labeled "Lack of Knowledge" (dark red, approximately 50.0%) and "Misinformation" (red, approximately 50.0%). All charts display percentage labels inside the slices, and the slices are distinguishable by color. The charts do not include a legend, and no slices are visually emphasized. The slices in each chart are not ordered in a particular way.
